description: Estimate the maximum loan and property price (SGD) a borrower can afford from monthly income, existing debt commitments and tenure, applying Singapore TDSR/MSR limits. Use this when you know the income and want the budget; for the income a target price needs, use `calculate_required_income`. For joint borrowers with assets and liabilities in detail, use `check_eligibility`.

cashSavings.description: Cash available for downpayment, in SGD.

citizenship.description: Buyer citizenship: singaporean, pr or foreigner. Drives ABSD rate.

cpfOA.description: CPF Ordinary Account balance usable, in SGD.

existingPropertiesOwned.description: Count of residential properties already owned; sets the ABSD tier (0, 1 or 2+). Takes precedence over existingProperty when provided.

existingProperty.description: True if the borrower already owns ≥1 property (affects ABSD and LTV).

interestRate.description: Assumed annual interest rate, as a percentage (e.g. 4.0 = 4%, not 0.04).

loanTenureYears.description: Repayment period, in years, over which the maximum loan is sized.

monthlyDebt.description: Total existing monthly debt commitments (other loans, cards), in SGD.

monthlyFixedIncome.description: Gross fixed monthly income (salary), in SGD.

monthlyVariableIncome.description: Gross variable monthly income (bonus/commission), in SGD; haircut 30% under TDSR.

propertyType.description: Property type: hdb, ec (Executive Condominium) or private. Sets MSR/LTV rules.

stressTestRate.description: Override the TDSR/MSR stress-test rate (percentage); defaults to the MAS floor.

name: calculate_affordability

absd.description: Additional Buyer’s Stamp Duty, in SGD.

absdRate.description: ABSD rate applied, as a decimal fraction (0.2 = 20%).

cpfUsageAllowed.description: CPF allowed toward downpayment, in SGD.

limitingFactor.description: Which limit bound the loan: "msr" or "tdsr" (null if neither binds).

ltv.description: Loan-to-value ratio applied, as a decimal fraction (0.75 = 75%).

maxLoan.description: Maximum loan the borrower qualifies for, in SGD.

maxPropertyPrice.description: Maximum affordable property price, in SGD.

minCashDownpayment.description: Minimum cash downpayment required, in SGD.

minCashPercent.description: Minimum cash portion of price, as a decimal fraction.

monthlyInstalment.description: Estimated monthly instalment at that loan, in SGD.

msrLimit.description: Monthly MSR cap (HDB/EC only), in SGD; null otherwise.

totalCashRequired.description: Total upfront cash needed (downpayment + duties + fees), in SGD.

title: Affordability calculator
